title: Target Practice
author: Ty_
rules:
I enjoy how chaotic those slingshot board states are. If you're stuck somewhere, try marking the slingshots that were resolved - you might have missed one or two that will help you along.

Sudoku

Each row, column, and region must contain the digits 1-9 once each.

Slingshots

An arrow inside a cell enters through one edge and points out of another. The digit in the cell behind the entering edge reappears N cells away in the direction the arrow points, where N is the digit in the arrow's own cell.

X

Cells separated by an X must sum to 10.
